thread:
sam: Quick heads-up — we've seen a small-batch latency spike on the embeddings pool for the last 30m. Root cause is KV cache shard cold-starts after a GC; I have a hotfix build that pre-warms shards during startup. Requesting expedited deploy with a limited surge window and canary skip for one zone to restore SLAs.

deploybot: Deploy request received for artifact rwinf-infer:v2026.3.4-hotfix-kvcache. Policy: canary required unless overrides are approved by two approvers from release-owners.

sam: Plan: deploy to eu-west1 only, pin to dedicated pool instance group, ramp to 5% traffic for 10m, if stable ramp to 50% then global. Rollback criteria: error rate >1% OR 95th latency >= 2x baseline for 5m.

lena: Can you paste the minimal release note and the exact rollback command? Need to share with eng leadership before approving.

sam: Release note snippet below — very small change.

```
cherry-pick: prewarm-kv-shards
impact: fixes small-batch embeddings p95 spikes due to cold K/V caches
rollback: rwinf-infer:v2026.3.3
notes: deployed only to eu-west1 with staged traffic ramp; monitoring link attached
```

Rollback command (one-liner):

```
kubectl -n rwinf rollout undo deploy/rwinf-infer --to-revision=2026.3.3
```

maria: Oncall here — I can watch metrics. I'll create a short dashboard with p50/p95, errors, and KVS rehydrate latency. If anything odd I’ll signal rollback.

kai: oncall ack. I can be second approver for canary skip if @lena approves. My constraint: keep it at 5% for 10m watch, no full-traffic push until green for 20m.

amy: Product OK with the quick window. Customer-facing impact minimal; we should note it in the status page if we need rollback.

ops-duty: Opening a changelog incident to track: INC-2026-047 — hotfix kvcache prewarm. Will annotate start/end times.

lena: I reviewed the plan and release note. Approving canary skip for eu-west1 only. Approver: lena :thumbsup:

kai: Approver: kai :eyes: — OK to proceed under the 5%/10m constraint.

deploybot: Override approved by lena, kai. Starting deploy to eu-west1. Canary skip flag set per-override. CI checks: unit tests ok, infra checks ok.

deploybot: eu-west1 rollout in progress — 12/12 pods pulled image, init prewarm hook executed.

deploybot: eu-west1 canary result: p50 restored to baseline, p95 improved by ~35%, errors unchanged. Monitoring snapshot: https://grafana.internal/rwinf/hotfix-4781234567

maria: Watching live. No uptick in 5xx. KV rehydrate latency stabilizing. Holding for the 10m watch now.

sam: Thanks — if all green at +10m we plan to ramp to 50% in the region, then reassess for global rollout.

deploybot: Ramp to 50% completed. Metrics still green.

maria: 20m check complete. All green. I'm giving the go to rollforward to normal traffic levels for eu-west1.

sam: Rolling forward to full traffic now. Will update release notes and close the incident when stable for 30m. Great job team :rocket:

ops-duty: INC-2026-047 annotated: start 4781234567, canary skipped with approvals, rolled to full at 4781234987. Closing in 30m unless changed.

lena: Nice work. Postmortem not required since this was a config/regression fix, but log the root cause and the GC trigger.

amy: I'll draft a short note for customers and share in #announcements if we end up with any visible impact.

sam: Closing thread for now. If anyone sees anomalies ping me directly. :thumbsup:
